基于概念的视觉模型行为的归纳和对比解释Concept-Based Abductive and Contrastive Explanations for Behaviors of Vision Models

Ronaldo Canizales rcanizal@colostate.edu
Colorado State University, Fort Collins CO, USA Divya Gopinath divya.gopinath@nasa.gov
KBR Inc., NASA Ames, Moffett Field CA, USA Corina Păsăreanu pcorina@andrew.cmu.edu
Carnegie Mellon University, Pittsburgh PA, USA Ravi Mangal ravi.mangal@colostate.edu
Colorado State University, Fort Collins CO, USA
摘要Abstract

基于概念的解释Concept-based explanations提供了一种有前途的方法，可以用人类可理解的高级概念来解释深度神经网络的预测。然而，现有的方法要么没有在概念和模型预测之间建立因果关系，要么表达能力有限，只能推断涉及单个概念的因果解释。与此同时，平行的工作线offer a promising approach for explaining the predictions of deep neural networks in terms of high-level, human-understandable concepts. However, existing methods either do not establish a causal connection between the concepts and model predictions or are limited in expressivity and only able to infer causal explanations involving single concepts. At the same time, the parallel line of work on正式的溯因和对比解释formal abductive and contrastive explanations计算与模型结果因果相关的最小输入特征集，但仅考虑像素等低级特征。合并这两个线程，在这项工作中，我们提出了以下概念：computes the minimal set of input features causally relevant for model outcomes but only considers low-level features such as pixels. Merging these two threads, in this work, we propose the notion of基于概念的溯因和对比解释concept-based abductive and contrastive explanations捕获与模型结果因果相关的最小高层概念集。然后，我们提出一系列算法，在使用时枚举所有最小解释that capture the minimal sets of high-level concepts causally relevant for model outcomes. We then present a family of algorithms that enumerate all minimal explanations while using概念擦除concept erasure建立因果关系的程序。通过适当地聚合这些解释，我们不仅能够理解对单个图像的模型预测，还能理解对图像集合的预测，其中模型表现出用户指定的、常见的特征。procedures to establish causal relationships. By appropriately aggregating such explanations, we are not only able to understand model predictions on individual images but also on collections of images where the model exhibits a user-specified, common行为behavior。我们在多个模型、数据集和行为上评估我们的方法，并证明其在计算有用的、用户友好的解释方面的有效性。. We evaluate our approach on multiple models, datasets, and behaviors, and demonstrate its effectiveness in computing helpful, user-friendly explanations.111代码可在Code is available athttps://github.com/CSU-TrustLab/behavior-explainer

1 简介Introduction

视觉任务中使用的深度神经网络的基于概念的解释 (ConXps) 将输出关联起来 (Concept-based explanations (ConXps) for deep neural networks used in vision tasks relate the outputs (行为behaviors）具有内部神经表示的模型，这些模型对人类可理解的语义概念或符号进行编码。 ConXps 的计算分两个步骤 - 首先，将概念的内部编码推断为模型激活空间中的向量；其次，确定概念对模型输出的影响。 影响分析的类型决定了 ConXps 的性质。开创性的方法) of models with internal neural representations that encode human-understandable semantic concepts or symbols. ConXps are computed in two steps—first, the internal encoding of concepts are inferred, typically, as vectors in the activation space of the models; second, the impact of the concepts on the model outputs is determined. The type of impact analysis dictates the nature of the ConXps. A seminal approachKim et al. (2018)估计模型输出对概念激活值变化的敏感性estimates the sensitivity of a model’s output to changes in concept activation values222概念激活值Concept activation value（或(or实力strength）是针对特定输入激活概念的程度。参见定义) is the degree to which a concept is activated for a particular input. See Definition2.5。这种方法的一个局限性是，它们不允许人们判断概念的激活对于模型的输出是否是必要的或充分的。其他方法使用. A limitation of such approaches is that they do not allow one to judge if the activation of a concept is necessary or sufficient for the model’s output. Other approaches use概念擦除concept erasure方法methodsBhalla et al. (2024); Belrose et al. (2023); Holstege et al. (2025); Ravfogel et al. (2022)通过从输入的内部激活中删除概念来确定模型输出的概念的必要性。如果删除概念会改变输出，那么这个概念就是必要的。然而，这些方法仅考虑单个概念的影响，无法判断何时需要多个概念来改变（或足以保留）模型输出。to determine the necessity of a concept for the model’s output by erasing the concept from the internal activations on an input. If erasing the concept changes the output, then the concept is necessary. However, these methods only consider the impact of individual concepts and are not able to judge when multiple concepts are necessary for changing (or sufficient for retaining) the model output.

平行的工作线A parallel line of work on正式的溯因和对比解释formal abductive and contrastive explanations Ignatiev et al. (2020b); Marques-Silva and Ignatiev (2022); Bassan et al. (2026)计算模型输出的充分（溯因）和必要（对比）特征的最小集合。每个解释可以包含多个特征。这些解释是computes the minimal sets of sufficient (abductive) and necessary (contrastive) features for a model’s output. Each explanation can comprise of more than one feature. These explanations are正式的formal因为它们保证推断的特征集确实是足够/必要的并且是最少的。计算此类解释通常会简化为通过 SAT 和 SMT 求解器等工具解决约束满足问题。然而，这些方法仅适用于低级特征（例如像素），而这些特征通常缺乏概念意义。由于约束求解的成本，这些方法也很难扩展到最先进的模型。since they guarantee that the inferred sets of features are indeed sufficient/necessary and minimal. Computing such explanations is typically reduced to solving constraint satisfaction problems via tools such as SAT and SMT solvers. However, these methods have been applied only in the context of low-level features such as pixels, which often lack conceptual meaning. These methods also struggle to scale to state-of-the-art models because of the costs of constraint solving.

为了解决这些先前工作的局限性，我们提出了以下概念：To address the limitations of these previous lines of work, we propose the notion of基于概念的溯因和对比解释concept-based abductive and contrastive explanations。基于概念的溯因解释 (ConAXps) 是最小的概念集，这样可以保留这些概念，同时从表示中删除所有其他概念，从而保持模型行为不变。基于概念的对比解释 (ConCXps) 是最小的概念集，因此在保留所有其他概念的同时删除这些概念会改变行为。. Concept-based abductive explanations (ConAXps) are minimal sets of concepts such that retaining these while erasing all other concepts from the representation keeps the model behavior unchanged. Concept-based contrastive explanations (ConCXps) are minimal sets of concepts such that erasing these while retaining all other concepts changes the behavior.

为了推断概念的内部表示，我们利用已知的技术To infer internal representations of concepts, we leverage known techniquesMangal et al. (2024); Dreyer et al. (2025)使用视觉语言模型，例如 CLIPthat use vision-language models, such as CLIPRadford et al. (2021)，作为理解（单独的）视觉模型学习的表示的语义镜头。这些方法依赖于三个关键观察结果。首先，从文本编码器中提取概念向量很便宜，并且不需要标记数据——可以使用描述相关概念的句子简单地通过文本编码器执行前向传递，以产生概念向量。其次，CLIP 的表示空间由其文本和图像编码器共享，以便图像的嵌入和相应的文本标题对齐。第三，视觉模型和CLIP的内部表示空间可以准确地相互映射。, as a semantic lens for understanding the representations learned by a (separate) vision model. These approaches rely on three key observations. First, extracting concept vectors from text encoders is cheap and requires no labeled data—one can simply perform a forward pass through the text encoders using sentences that describe the relevant concept to yield a concept vector. Second, CLIP’s representation space is shared by its text and image encoders such that embeddings of images and respective text captions are aligned. Third, the internal representation spaces of vision models and CLIP can be accurately mapped to each other.

给定概念向量，我们提出三种不同的算法来计算 ConXps：（1）朴素算法（NaiveEnum），从具有单个概念的集合开始，详尽地枚举每个可能的概念集合，并检查该集合是否是 ConAXp 或 ConCXp； (2) 改编自正式解释文献的算法（XpEnum）Given concept vectors, we present three different algorithms to compute ConXps: (1) a naive algorithm (NaiveEnum) that exhaustively enumerates every possible set of concepts, starting from sets with single concepts, and checks if the set is a ConAXp or ConCXp; (2) an algorithm (XpEnum) adapted from the formal explanations literatureIgnatiev et al. (2020b)使用命中集的概念，并利用溯因解释和对比解释之间已知的二元性； (3) 一种新颖的算法 (XpSatEnum)，专门用于寻找给定图像集中常见的解释。所有三种算法对于概念擦除过程都是参数化的。在这项工作中，我们评估了三种不同的概念擦除方法。这些方法的不同之处在于如何从表示中删除概念。其中两种方法已在先前的工作中提出that uses the notion of hitting sets and exploits a known duality between abductive and contrastive explanations; and (3) a novel algorithm (XpSatEnum) that is explicitly geared towards finding explanations that are common across a given set of images. All three algorithms are parametric with respect to the concept erasure procedure. In this work, we evaluate three different concept erasure methods. The methods differ in how they erase the concept from the representation. Two of the methods have been proposed in prior workBhalla et al. (2024); Belrose et al. (2023)。我们提出的新擦除方法基于这样的直觉：擦除后，表示应该与表示被擦除概念的所有概念向量正交，同时尽可能与原始表示相似。. The new erasure method we propose is based on the intuition that after erasure, the representation should be orthogonal to all the concept vectors that represent the erased concepts while being as similar as possible to the original representation.

我们在三种不同的视觉分类器（即零样本 CLIP、ResNet18 和 VGG19）以及两个数据集（RIVAL-10We evaluate our approach on three different vision classifiers, namely, zero-shot CLIP, ResNet18, and VGG19 and two datasets (RIVAL-10Moayeri et al. (2022)和欧洲卫星and EuroSATHelber et al. (2019)）。为了获得以下解释). To obtain explanations that are一般general，即它们解释模型表现出共同行为的图像集上的模型输出，我们聚合每个图像计算的 ConXps 以构建 ConXps 的直方图，作为对一组输入图像上的模型行为的解释。图, i.e., they explain model outputs on sets of images where the model exhibits a common behavior, we aggregate the ConXps computed per image to construct a histogram of ConXps as the explanation for model behavior on a set of input images. Figure1给出了我们能够推断的解释类型的示例。我们的实验表明，使用我们的方法计算的 ConXps 是稀疏的——一些简短的解释就能够解释所考虑的集合中大部分图像的模型输出。我们的解释是可概括的，因为它们甚至适用于模型表现出相同行为的看不见的图像。此外，解释的基于概念的性质使得很容易判断模型是否依赖于相关和不相关的概念。gives an example of the types of explanations we are able to infer. Our experiments reveal that the ConXps computed using our methods are sparse—a few short explanations are able to explain model output for a large majority of the images in the considered set. Our explanations are generalizable in the sense that they are applicable even for unseen images where the model exhibits the same behavior. Moreover, the concept-based nature of the explanations makes it easy to judge if the model relies on relevant and irrelevant concepts.

2.2.1 基于 CLIP 的表示代理CLIP-based Representation Surrogates

在这项工作中，我们利用使用视觉语言模型 CLIP 作为语义镜头的方法来理解视觉模型学习的表示。这些方法依赖于任意视觉模型的嵌入与 CLIP 的联合视觉语言嵌入之间存在线性映射的观察In this work, we leverage methods that use the vision-language model CLIP as a semantic lens to understand the representations learned by vision models. These methods rely on the observation that there exist linear mappings between the embeddings of arbitrary vision models and the joint vision-language embeddings of CLIPMoayeri et al. (2023)。 CLIP 嵌入空间的多模态性质使得在 CLIP 空间中提取概念向量变得简单，而不需要概念标记数据。嵌入空间之间的线性映射允许通过将视觉模型嵌入映射到 CLIP 空间来分析视觉模型嵌入的语义内容。. The multi-modal nature of the CLIP embedding space makes it straightforward to extract concept vectors in the CLIP space without needing concept-labeled data. The linear maps between the embedding spaces allow analyzing the semantic content of vision model embeddings by mapping them to the CLIP space.

在 CLIP 空间中提取概念向量。Extracting Concept Vectors in CLIP Space.

和过去的工作一样As in past workMangal et al. (2024)，我们使用 CLIP 文本编码器来提取概念向量。对于给定的概念，我们构建一组引用该概念的标题（参见附录, we use the CLIP text encoder to extract concept vectors. For a given concept, we construct a set of captions referring to that concept (see AppendixD举个例子）。这些字幕均通过 CLIP 的文本编码器传递，并对所得嵌入进行平均和归一化以获得相应的概念向量。据观察for an example). These captions are all passed through CLIP’s text encoder and the resulting embeddings are averaged and normalized to obtain the corresponding concept vector. As observed byLiang et al. (2022)，在 CLIP 的联合嵌入空间中，图像和文本嵌入之间存在模态差距——这些嵌入位于不同的锥体中。为了解决这一差距，以下, there exists a modality gap between the image and text embeddings in CLIP’s joint embedding space—these embeddings lie in separate cones. To address this gap, followingBhalla et al. (2024)，我们, we平均中心mean-center图像和概念嵌入（参见附录the image and the concept embeddings (see AppendixD了解详情）。for details).

从视觉模型到 CLIP 的映射以及返回。Mapping from Vision Models to CLIP and Back.

我们构建学习地图的问题We frame the problem of learning the mapW​z+dWz+d从视觉模型到CLIP嵌入空间的优化问题如下：from the vision model to the CLIP embedding space as the following optimization problem:

W,d:=arg​minW,d⁡1|Dt​r​a​i​n|​∑x∈Dt​r​a​i​n‖W⋅Me​n​c​(x)+d−Mi​m​gC​L​I​P​(x)‖22.W,d:=\operatorname*{arg\,min}_{W,d}\frac{1}{|D_{train}|}\sum_{x\in D_{train}}\|W\cdot M^{enc}(x)+d-M^{CLIP}_{img}(x)\|_{2}^{2}. (1)

哪里whereDt​r​a​i​nD_{train}是一组训练图像并且is the set of training images andMi​m​gC​L​I​PM^{CLIP}_{img}是CLIP的图像编码器。 从 CLIP 空间到视觉模型空间的映射也是类似地学习的。 我们设计了健全性检查来判断这些地图的质量。见附录is CLIP’s image encoder. The map from CLIP space to vision model space is learned similarly. We design a sanity check to judge the quality of these maps. See AppendixD.1了解详情。for details.

2.2.2 概念优势和消除Concept Strengths and Erasure

直观上，概念强度或概念激活值的概念是针对特定输入激活概念的程度。词汇表中所有概念的概念强度共同构成强度向量。Intuitively, the notion of concept strength or concept activation value is the degree to which a concept is activated for a particular input. The concept strengths for all the concepts in the vocabulary together constitute a strength vector.

定义2.5Definition 2.5 （概念强度向量）(Concept Strength Vector).

给定图像嵌入Given an image embeddingz∈ℤz\in\mathbb{Z}，概念词汇表, a vocabulary of concepts𝒞={c1,c2,…,cn}\mathcal{C}=\{c_{1},c_{2},\dots,c_{n}\}及其对应的概念向量and their corresponding concept vectorsc1→,c2→,…,cn→\vec{c_{1}},\vec{c_{2}},\dots,\vec{c_{n}}，概念强度向量，, the concept strength vector,s​t​(z)st(z)，由下式给出, is given by∀i∈{1,…,n}.s​t​(z)i:=c​o​s​(z,ci→).\forall i\in\{1,\dots,n\}.\penalty 10000\ st(z)_{i}:=cos(z,\vec{c_{i}}).333可以使用其他方法来计算概念强度，例如通过将嵌入投影到概念向量上或通过根据概念向量对嵌入进行稀疏线性分解。Concept strengths can be calculated using other methods such as via projection of the embedding onto the concept vectors or through a sparse linear decomposition of the embedding in terms of the concept vectors.

请注意，Note that the实力strength强度向量中的概念可以是正数、负数或零。of concept in the strength vector can be positive, negative, or zero.

概念擦除可确保概念不再存在于图像的嵌入中。Concept erasure ensures that a concept is no longer present in the embedding of an image.

定义2.6Definition 2.6 （概念擦除）(Concept Erasure).

给定图像嵌入Given an image embeddingz∈ℤz\in\mathbb{Z}，概念词汇表, a vocabulary of concepts𝒞={c1,c2,…,cn}\mathcal{C}=\{c_{1},c_{2},\dots,c_{n}\}，以及一个概念, and a conceptcic_{i}被擦除，to be erased,e​r​a​s​e​(z,ci)∈ℤerase(z,c_{i})\in\mathbb{Z}是一个is acic_{i}-删除嵌入如果-erased embedding if∀j∈{1.…,n}.st(erase(z,ci))j=0 if i=j else st(z)j.\forall j\in\{1.\dots,n\}.\penalty 10000\ st(erase(z,c_{i}))_{j}=0\text{ if }i=j\text{ else }st(z)_{j}.

我们将滥用符号并写We will abuse notation and writee​r​a​s​e​(z,b)erase(z,b), 其中, wherebb是长度的布尔向量is a boolean vector of lengthnn，引用嵌入, to refer to an embeddingzz所有概念都在哪里where all the conceptscic_{i}这样such thatbi=0b_{i}=0被删除。 请注意，在实践中，擦除过程也可能会修改未被擦除的概念的强度。我们在章节中进一步讨论这个问题are erased. Note that, in practice, erasure procedures might also modify the strength of the concepts not being erased. We discuss this further in Section4.1.

4 算法Algorithms

4.1 擦除算法Erasure Algorithms

人们已经开发了各种方法来从模型表示中删除概念。所有这些方法都试图在确保成功擦除和最小化对原始嵌入的修改之间取得平衡。在本文中，我们使用并比较了三种不同的概念擦除方法，即正交擦除（Ortho）、SPLiCE式擦除（SPLiCE）Various methods have been developed to erase concepts from model representations. All these methods attempt to strike a balance between ensuring successful erasure and minimizing the modifications to the original embedding. In this paper, we use and compare three different methods for concept erasure, namely, orthogonal erasure (Ortho), SPLiCE-style erasure (SPLiCE)Bhalla et al. (2024)、和莱斯, and LEACEBelrose et al. (2023).

This can be expressed as a constrained optimization with the following closed-form solution (see AppendixC详细推导），for a detailed derivation),

算法Algorithm1描述了一种朴素的方法，详尽地列举了describes a naive approach that exhaustively enumerates all the elements of2𝒞2^{\mathcal{C}}，从空的概念集开始。虽然此方法可以保证找到所有 ConAXps 和 ConCXps，但对于实践中需要的包含数百或数千个概念的大型概念词汇表来说，其计算量是巨大的。我们使用深度有界搜索树来保持易处理性。通过将最大搜索深度固定为一个值, starting from the empty set of concepts. While this method is guaranteed finding all ConAXps and ConCXps, it is computationally prohibitive for the large concept vocabularies with hundreds or thousands of concepts that are needed in practice. XpEnum。XpEnum.

我们采用 XpEnum 算法We adapt the XpEnum algorithm ofIgnatiev et al. (2020b)，它利用 AXps 和 CXps 之间的命中集对偶性来同时枚举两种类型的解释。该算法维护迄今为止找到的 ConAXps 和 ConCXps 集。在每次迭代中，它都会计算找到的 ConCXp 的最小命中集（前提是不是任何找到的 ConAXp 的超集）作为候选。如果候选者通过了 WeakConAXp 检查（在单调性下，减少为单个预言机调用），它就会收缩为 ConAXp。否则，它的补集是 WeakConCXp，并收缩为 ConCXp。新找到的解释被添加到相应的集合中，并且重复该过程，直到不存在新的候选。完整详情请参阅附录, which exploits the hitting set duality between AXps and CXps to simultaneously enumerate both types of explanations. The algorithm maintains the sets of ConAXps and ConCXps found so far. At each iteration, it computes a minimal hitting set of the found ConCXps (subject to not being a superset of any found ConAXp) as a candidate. If the candidate passes the WeakConAXp check—which, under monotonicity, reduces to a single oracle call—it is shrunk to a ConAXp. Otherwise, its complement is a WeakConCXp and is shrunk to a ConCXp. The newly found explanation is added to the corresponding collection, and the process repeats until no new candidates exist. Full details are in AppendixB.

XpSatEnum。XpSatEnum.

If so, the explanation is shrunk to a控制XpConXp（详细信息(details of the收缩XpShrinkXp程序见附录procedure are in AppendixB）。这种跨图像饱和度最大化了跨图像的最终解释集的重叠。使用相同的算法通过适当的检查使 ConAXps 和 ConCXps 饱和。该方法利用了经验观察，即少数解释通常代表给定行为的大多数实例。). This cross-image saturation maximizes the overlap of the final explanation sets across images. The same algorithm is used for saturating both ConAXps and ConCXps with the appropriate checks. This method leverages the empirical observation that a minority of explanations are usually representative of most instances of a given behavior.

5.2.1 RQ1：普遍性RQ1: Generalizability

一个解释是An explanation is可概括的generalizable如果它适用于同一行为的不同样本。一般性解释抓住了模型为何表现出特定行为的本质，​​而不是简单地解释单个图像上的模型输出。为了评估我们的解释的普遍性，我们定义了以下指标。if it is applicable across different samples of the same behavior. A general explanation captures the essence of why the model exhibits a specific behavior as opposed to simply explaining model output on a single image. To evaluate the generalizability of our explanations, we define the following metric.

定义5.1Definition 5.1 （普遍性@K）(Generalizability@K).

给定两个不相交的子集Given two disjoint subsetsBMv​i​st​r​nB^{trn}_{M^{vis}}和andBMv​i​st​s​tB^{tst}_{M^{vis}}某种行为的of a behaviorBMv​i​sB_{M^{vis}}，以及这些行为子集相应的基于概念的解释，, and corresponding concept-based explanations of these behavior subsets,(hAt​r​n,hCt​r​n)(h^{trn}_{A},h^{trn}_{C})和and(hAt​s​t,hCt​s​t)(h^{tst}_{A},h^{tst}_{C})（其中(wherehAh_{A}和andhCh_{C}是从签名的 ConAXps 和 ConCXps 到定义中所述的计数的映射are maps from signed ConAXps and ConCXps to counts as described in Definition3.9），泛化性@K定义为：), Generalizability@K is defined as:

Gen@K​(BMv​i​st​r​n,BMv​i​st​s​t):=(|T​o​p​K​(hAt​r​n)∩T​o​p​K​(hAt​s​t)||T​o​p​K​(hAt​r​n)∪T​o​p​K​(hAt​s​t)|,|T​o​p​K​(hCt​r​n)∩T​o​p​K​(hCt​s​t)||T​o​p​K​(hCt​r​n)∪T​o​p​K​(hCt​s​t)|)\text{Gen@K}(B^{trn}_{M^{vis}},B^{tst}_{M^{vis}}):=\left(\frac{|TopK(h^{trn}_{A})\cap TopK(h^{tst}_{A})|}{|TopK(h^{trn}_{A})\cup TopK(h^{tst}_{A})|},\frac{|TopK(h^{trn}_{C})\cap TopK(h^{tst}_{C})|}{|TopK(h^{trn}_{C})\cup TopK(h^{tst}_{C})|}\right)

哪里whereT​o​p​K​(h)TopK(h)返回顶部returns the topkk地图上最常见的解释most frequent explanations in the maphh.

通过将行为的图像随机划分为两个不相交的子集来比较它们最常见的解释来评估泛化性@K。我们使用这两个集合的前 k 个最常见解释的并交交集 (IoU) 作为跨样本解释泛化的衡量标准。 IoU 为 1 表示最常见的基于概念的解释在两个行为子集之间完全一致，表明这些解释代表了该行为的广义、通用解释。相反，IoU 为 0 意味着最常见的解释完全依赖于样本，表明无法找到该行为的通用解释。 鉴于这组可能的基于概念的解释由数千个独特元素组成，偶然获得高 IoU 的概率在统计上可以忽略不计。因此，两个不相交集合之间任何显着的解释重叠都为解释的高质量和普遍性提供了有力的证据。Generalizability@K is evaluated by randomly partitioning a behavior’s images into two disjoint subsets to compare their most frequent explanations. We use the Intersection over Union (IoU) of the top k most frequent explanations for the two sets as a measure of generalization of explanations across samples. An IoU of 1 indicates that the most frequent concept-based explanations are perfectly aligned between the two behavior subsets, suggesting that those explanations represent a generalized, universal explanation of that behavior. In contrast, an IoU of 0 implies that the most frequent explanations are entirely sample-dependent, indicating a failure in finding a generalized explanation for that behavior. Given that the set of possible concept-based explanations consists of thousands of unique elements, the probability of obtaining a high IoU by chance is statistically negligible. Therefore, any significant explanation overlap between the two disjoint sets provides strong evidence for the high quality and generalizability of the explanations.

Results for other models are available in AppendixG.1。在增加的同时. While increasingKK最初通过包含更常见的解释来提高 IoU，随着集合开始包含低频、特定于样本的解释，我们预计泛化性会在更高的值（例如数百个）下降低。这么高initially improves IoU by including more common explanations, we expect generalizability to decrease at much higher values (e.g., in the hundreds) as the sets begin to include low-frequency, sample-specific explanations. Such highKK值对于人类分析师来说是不切实际的，所以我们选择values are impractical for human analysts, so we choseK=5K=5作为合理的上限。 在我们研究的行为中，正确和错误的分类都观察到类似的概括性值。as a reasonable upper bound. Similar generalizability values are observed for both correct and incorrect classifications in the behaviors we studied.

概括性值对解释长度高度敏感；较长的解释往往会报告较低的值，因为 IoU 将即使只有一个概念也不同的集合视为不同的。虽然擦除算法的选择通常影响很小，但 LEACE 和 NaiveEnum 组合始终提供高 IoU 值，请参见附录Generalizability values are highly sensitive to explanation length; longer explanations tend to report lower values because IoU treats sets that differ by even a single concept as distinct. While the choice of erasure algorithm generally has a small impact, the LEACE and NaiveEnum combination consistently provides high IoU values, see AppendixG.1以获得更多结果。for more results.

5.2.2 RQ2：覆盖范围RQ2: Coverage

对于我们探索的数据集和行为，独特解释的总数可以达到数百或数千，超出了人类分析师的认知能力。 选择适用于行为中大多数图像的一小部分解释对于实际实用性至关重要。一小组使分析师能够优先考虑高度相关的概念模式，而不是考虑每个案例。我们定义下一个指标来量化覆盖范围和子集大小的平衡，如下所示。For the datasets and behaviors we have explored, the total number of unique explanations can reach hundreds or thousands, exceeding the cognitive capacity of a human analyst. Selecting a small subset of explanations that applies to the majority of images in a behavior is essential for practical utility. A small set enables an analyst to prioritize highly-relevant concept patterns rather than accounting for every case. We define the next metric to quantify this balance of coverage and subset size as follows.

定义5.2Definition 5.2 （最大覆盖范围@K）(Maximum Coverage@K).

给定一个行为Given a behaviorBMv​i​sB_{M^{vis}}, 型号, modelMv​i​sM^{vis}、概念词汇, concept vocabulary𝒞\mathcal{C}，以及一个解释枚举器, and an explanation enumeratorℰ\mathcal{E}, 让, let𝒳​p​s^A\widehat{\mathcal{X}ps}_{A}是所有唯一签名的 ConAXps 的集合（即，be the set of all unique signed ConAXps (i.e.,𝒳​p​s^A={(𝒳,s​m​a​p)|v∈BMv​i​s∧𝒳∈π1​(ℰ​(Mv​i​s,v,𝒞))∧s​m​a​p=s​g​n​(𝒳,Mv​i​s,v)}\widehat{\mathcal{X}ps}_{A}=\{(\mathcal{X},smap)\penalty 10000\ |\penalty 10000\ v\in B_{M^{vis}}\penalty 10000\ \wedge\penalty 10000\ \mathcal{X}\in\pi_{1}(\mathcal{E}(M^{vis},v,\mathcal{C}))\penalty 10000\ \wedge\penalty 10000\ smap=sgn(\mathcal{X},M^{vis},v)\}）由行为的枚举器找到。) found by the enumerator for the behavior.𝒳​p​s^C\widehat{\mathcal{X}ps}_{C}是所有类似定义的唯一签名 ConCXps 的集合。我们将最大覆盖率@K定义为可以由K签名的ConAXps（对于ConCXps类似）解释的最大图像数量。is the set of all unique signed ConCXps defined analogously. We define Maximum Coverage@K as the maximum number of images that can be explained by K signed ConAXps (similarly, for ConCXps).

MaxCov@K​(BMv​i​s):=(maxSA⁡|⋃𝒳i∈SAB𝒳i|,maxSC⁡|⋃𝒳i∈SCB𝒳i|)​ s.t. ​SA⊆𝒳​p​s^A,SC⊆𝒳​p​s^C,|SA|=|SC|=K\text{MaxCov@K}(B_{M^{vis}}):=\left(\max_{S_{A}}\left|\bigcup_{\mathcal{X}_{i}\in{S_{A}}}B^{\mathcal{X}_{i}}\right|,\max_{S_{C}}\left|\bigcup_{\mathcal{X}_{i}\in{S_{C}}}B^{\mathcal{X}_{i}}\right|\right)\text{ s.t. }{S_{A}}\subseteq\widehat{\mathcal{X}ps}_{A},{S_{C}}\subseteq\widehat{\mathcal{X}ps}_{C},|S_{A}|=|S_{C}|=K

哪里whereB𝒳i⊆BMv​i​sB^{\mathcal{X}_{i}}\subseteq B_{M^{vis}}是一组图像，其中is the set of images for which𝒳i\mathcal{X}_{i}是一份签名解释。is a signed explanation.

这是一个例子This is an instance of the最大覆盖问题Maximum Coverage Problem，一个 NP 困难问题，其中给定一个集合的一组子集——在我们的例子中，子集, an NP-hard problem where given a set of subsets of a set—in our case, subsets{B𝒳1,B𝒳2,…​B𝒳n}\{B^{\mathcal{X}_{1}},B^{\mathcal{X}_{2}},\dots B^{\mathcal{X}_{n}}\}组数of setBMv​i​sB_{M^{vis}}——和一个整数—and an integerKK，目标是最多选择, the goal is to select at mostKK最大化所覆盖的唯一元素总数的子集。我们使用贪婪策略迭代选择下一个解释subsets that maximize the total number of unique elements covered. We use a greedy strategy that iteratively selects the next explanation𝒳i\mathcal{X}_{i}图像覆盖范围的边际增益最高；算法详述见附录with the highest marginal gain in image coverage; algorithm detailed in AppendixF.

如图As shown in Figure5，我们报告归一化最大覆盖率@, we report the Normalized Maximum Coverage@KK，其中 MaxCov@K 中的解释所解释的图像数量除以感兴趣行为中的图像总数。值为 1 表示所选解释子集涵盖整个行为。我们的实验表明，只需要一小部分解释就可以解释行为中的大多数图像：在探索的所有四种行为中，至少一种擦除算法实现了归一化最大覆盖值 1，其中, where the number of images explained by the explanations in MaxCov@K is divided by the total number of images in the behavior of interest. A value of 1 indicates the selected subset of explanations covers the entire behavior. Our experiment shows that only a small subset of explanations is required to account for the majority of images within a behavior: across all four behaviors explored, at least one erasure algorithm achieves a normalized maximum coverage value of 1 withK≤5K\leq 5解释，而亚军候选人可靠地这样做了explanations, while runner-up candidates reliably do so withK≤10K\leq 10;更多结果见附录; more results at AppendixG.2。考虑到搜索空间包含数千个独特的解释，用 10 个或更少的解释实现完全覆盖的能力证明了我们方法的实用性。值得注意的是，没有任何一种擦除算法能够始终优于其他算法。相反，他们的表现似乎取决于行为。这一实证观察为未来的研究指明了机会。. Considering that the search space contains thousands of unique explanations, the ability to achieve full coverage with 10 or fewer explanations demonstrates the practical utility of our approach. Notably, no single erasure algorithm consistently outperforms the others; instead, their performance appears to be behavior-dependent. This empirical observation points to an opportunity for future research.

The empirical results show that the distribution of individual coverages is highly skewed across all behaviors. A small number of explanations report high individual coverages, while a large number of explanations apply only to a few instances. 5.2.3 RQ3：简约RQ3: Parsimony

遵循奥卡姆剃刀原理Following Occam’s razorRasmussen and Ghahramani (2000)，或简约法则，建议寻找用尽可能最小的元素集构建的解释，, or the law of parsimony, which recommends searching for explanations constructed with the smallest possible set of elements,Sokol and Flach (2020)说明解释应有选择性且足够简洁，以避免不必要的信息淹没被解释者，即用最少的论点填补最多的空白。state that explanations should be selective and succinct enough to avoid overwhelming the explainee with unnecessary information, i.e., fill in the most gaps with the fewest arguments.

我们分析解释大小（定义为包含的概念数量）与个体覆盖率之间的关联。图We analyze the association between explanation size, defined as the number of included concepts, and individual coverage. This suggests that parsimonious explanations are more likely to capture the broad, systematic patterns of a model’s behavior.

5.2.4 RQ4：合理性RQ4: Plausibility

我们通过评估每个解释的构成概念是否合理来对每个解释的合理性进行分类We categorize the plausibility of each explanation by evaluating if its constituent concepts are相关的relevant到模型行为。签署的解释是to the model behavior. A signed explanation is完全合理fully plausible如果它的所有积极概念都与该行为相关，而所有消极概念都与该行为无关。相反，如果所有积极概念都不相关而消极概念相关，则解释是完全不可信的。测量合理、部分合理和不合理的解释总数的比例可以作为确定视觉模型的决策是基于相关概念还是基于虚假相关性的透镜。继if all its positive concepts are relevant and all its negative concepts are irrelevant for the behavior. In contrast, an explanation is fully implausible if all positive concepts are irrelevant and negative concepts are relevant. Measuring the fraction of the total number of explanations that are plausible, partially plausible, and implausible acts as a lens to determine if the vision model’s decisions are based on relevant concepts or on spurious correlations. Following the法学硕士法官LLM-as-a-judge策略strategyLi et al. (2025)，我们使用Gemini 3 Pro, we utilized Gemini 3 ProGoogle DeepMind (2026)将我们的基础词汇中的每个概念分类为与所考虑的模型行为相关或无关。请参阅附录to classify each concept in our base vocabulary as relevant or irrelevant for the model behavior under consideration. Please refer to AppendixH用于使用提示模板。for prompt templates used.

如图As shown in Figure9，评估的视觉模型显示出倾向于合理的解释而不是不合理的解释。然而，很大一部分解释只是部分合理，这表明许多决策是基于相关概念和虚假概念的混合。这些虚假概念通常代表与行为高度相关但不具有因果关系的特征，例如船舶图像中存在水。部分合理解释的存在表明，虽然模型优先考虑相关特征，但它们在许多决策中仍然使用非必要的上下文信息。, the evaluated vision models show a tendency towards plausible explanations over implausible ones. However, a significant proportion of explanations are only partially plausible, indicating that many decisions are based on a mix of relevant and spurious concepts. These spurious concepts often represent features that are highly correlated with a behavior but are not causal, such as the presence of water in images of ships. The existence of partially plausible explanations suggests that while models prioritize relevant features, they still use non-essential contextual information in many of their decisions.

More results in AppendixG.4。 在研究的模型和行为中，CLIP 通常提供较高比例的合理解释，紧随其后的是 ResNet。相比之下，VGG 报告的可信度最低，并且虚假相关的频率较高。这种差异可能归因于线性映射的性能，请参见附录. Among the models and behaviors studied, CLIP generally provides a higher percentage of plausible explanations, followed closely by ResNet. In contrast, VGG reports the lowest plausibility and a higher frequency of spurious correlations. This difference may be attributed to the performance of linear maps, see AppendixD.1，而不是模型的内在逻辑；这一实证观察开启了一项有趣的未来研究。, rather than the models’ inherent logic; this empirical observation opens an interesting future study.

我们将擦除算法与解释枚举算法的每次组合所需的时间进行比较，以计算每个图像的解释。我们将每个这样的组合称为We compare the time required per combination of a erasure algorithm with an explanation enumeration algorithm to compute explanations per image. (2018); Belrose et al. (2023); Elazar et al. (2021); Ravfogel et al. (2021)。视觉语言模型可以在文本概念空间中提供基础解释. Vision-language models enable grounding explanations in textual concept spacesKim et al. (2023); Bhalla et al. (2024); Gandelsman et al. (2024); Balasubramanian et al. (2024); Papadimitriou et al. (2025)。最近的工作利用 VLM 通过映射各自的表示空间来解释、调试和监控视觉模型. Recent work leverages VLMs to interpret, debug, and monitor vision models by mapping their respective representation spacesHu et al. (2025)。密切相关的是对从程序场景描述或因果抽象派生的结构化语义变量执行形式推理的方法. Closely related are methods performing formal reasoning over structured semantic variables derived from programmatic scene descriptions or causal abstractionsKim et al. (2020); Rajendran et al. (2024); Bassan et al. (2023).

我们的工作通过对语义上有意义的概念进行正式的溯因和对比解释，将形式解释方法和基于概念的可解释性联系起来。我们的新颖之处在于将语义基础（利用 VLM）与最小性和因果相关性的保证结合起来。Our work bridges formal explanation methods and concept-based interpretability by enabling formally grounded abductive and contrastive explanations over semantically meaningful concepts. Our novelty lies in combining semantic grounding (leveraging VLMs) with guarantees of minimality and causal relevance.

7 结论Conclusion

我们提出了基于概念的溯因和对比解释的新概念。这些解释根据充分或必要概念的最小集合为模型行为提供了因果解释。因果关系是通过从内部模型表示中删除概念来确定的。我们提出了三种算法，在概念擦除过程中参数化，用于枚举此类解释。我们的算法假设模型头在概念方面是单调的。我们还基于直觉提出了一种新的概念擦除过程，即擦除后的表示应该与每个被擦除的概念正交，同时尽可能与原始表示相似。对于我们分析的模型和行为，简短的、人类可以理解的解释往往是最具解释性的。推断的解释也可以推广到模型表现出相同行为的看不见的图像。作为未来的工作，我们计划将这些方法应用于 LLM 和 VLM，其中模型行为是通过生成的文本序列而不是分类预测来表征的。我们预计这种更丰富的行为需要在我们基于概念的解释中添加时间方面，以解释这些模型的自回归性质。We presented the new notion of concept-based abductive and contrastive explanations. These explanations provide causal explanations for model behaviors in terms of minimal sets of sufficient or necessary concepts. Causality is determined by erasing the concepts from internal model representations. We presented three algorithms, parametric in the concept erasure procedure, for enumerating such explanations. Our algorithms assume that the model head is monotonic with respect to concepts. We also presented a new concept erasure procedure based on the intuition that the representation, after erasure, should be orthogonal to each of the erased concepts while being as similar to original representation as possible. For the models and behaviors we analyze, short, human-understandable, explanations tend to be most explanatory. The inferred explanations also generalize to unseen images where the model exhibits the same behavior. As future work, we plan to apply these methods to LLMs and VLMs where model behaviors are characterized over sequences of generated texts instead of categorical predictions. We expect this richer behavior to necessitate adding a temporal aspect to our concept-based explanations to account for the auto-regressive nature of these models.

我们采用 XpEnum 算法We adapt the XpEnum algorithm ofIgnatiev et al. (2020b)列举基于概念的正式解释。原始算法利用溯因解释和对比解释之间的命中集对偶性（AXps 是 CXps 的最小命中集，反之亦然）来同时枚举两种类型的解释。我们将其适应基于概念的设置，其中蕴涵检查在单调性假设下减少为单个预言机调用（定理to enumerate concept-based formal explanations. The original algorithm exploits the hitting set duality between abductive and contrastive explanations (AXps are minimal hitting sets of CXps and vice-versa) to simultaneously enumerate both types of explanations. We adapt this to our concept-based setting, where the entailment checks reduce to single oracle calls under the monotonicity assumption (Theorem3.1).

正在关注FollowingBhalla et al. (2024)，作者根据经验发现 CLIP 图像和文本嵌入存在于嵌入空间的两个锥体上，他们建议对概念向量和图像嵌入应用均值中心化过程，然后对概念向量和图像嵌入进行归一化操作，分别使用概念均值和图像均值，计算整个词汇表和感兴趣数据集的所有图像；在我们的例子中，我们使用符合 MSCOCO 字幕中 13K 最常见单词的词汇表 RIVAL10 和 EuroSAT 数据集各包含 20K 和 27K 图像。我们也将此过程应用于类向量。, where the authors empirically found that CLIP image and text embeddings exist on two cones of the embedding space, they suggest applying a mean-centering procedure followed by a normalization operation to both concept vectors and image embeddings, using a concept mean and an image mean, respectively, computed over a entire vocabulary and all images of a dataset of interest; in our case we use the vocabulary conformed by the 13K most frequent words in MSCOCO captions and the RIVAL10 and EuroSAT datasets consisting of 20K and 27K images each. We apply this procedure to class vectors as well.

D.1 嵌入空间之间线性映射的健全性检查Sanity Checks for Linear Maps Between Embedding Spaces

我们验证了第 2.2.1 节中讨论的视觉模型和 CLIP 嵌入空间之间的线性映射，以确保转换保留与概念相关的信息。相关工作We validate the linear mapping discussed in Section 2.2.1 between vision model and CLIP embedding spaces to ensure the transformation preserves concept-related information. Related workMangal et al. (2024); Merullo et al. (2023)使用线性映射来转换一个模型的嵌入，以匹配相同输入的另一模型的嵌入。我们更进一步，将这些向量映射回原始视觉模型空间。这种逆映射确保 CLIP 空间中的编辑（例如概念擦除）在返回到原始模型后仍然有效。我们使用概念激活向量 (CAV) 来衡量这种一致性uses linear maps to transform embeddings from one model to match embeddings of another model for the same inputs. We go one step further by mapping these vectors back to the original vision model space. This inverse mapping ensures that edits in the CLIP space, such as concept erasure, remain effective after returning to the original model. We measure this consistency using Concept Activation Vectors (CAVs)Kim et al. (2018)。每个CAV都是通过训练Ridge线性模型得到的. Each CAV is obtained by training a Ridge linear model444请参阅 https://scikit-learn.org/stable/modules/ generated/sklearn.linear_model.Ridge.htmlSee https://scikit-learn.org/stable/modules/generated/sklearn.linear_model.Ridge.html区分包含特定概念的嵌入和不包含特定概念的嵌入。我们首先正式定义逆映射和基于 CAV 的概念强度，为我们的三个健全性检查提供基础。to distinguish embeddings containing a specific concept from those that do not. We first formally define Inverse Maps and CAV-based Concept Strength to provide the foundation for our three sanity checks.

(2024)它从与任务无关的基本词汇开始，然后对其进行修剪。这确保了词汇表在不同下游预测任务中的广泛适用性。基本词汇由 MSCOCO 字幕中最常出现的大约 13K 个单词组成which starts with a task-agnostic base vocabulary and then prunes it. The base vocabulary comprises of approximately 13K words that appear most frequently in MSCOCO captionsLin et al. (2015)。为了确保所有单词都有意义，我们将此集合与 CoreWordNet 相交. To ensure all words are meaningful, we intersect this set with CoreWordNetKhodak et al. (2017); Clark et al. (2008)，一个词典，其中每个单词都具有明确的含义。这个过程过滤掉缺乏概念权重的常见功能词（例如“a”、“the”、“in”）。最后，为了最大限度地减少冗余，我们使用 CLIP 文本嵌入来计算所有概念对之间的余弦相似度，并且对于相似度超过的每对概念, a lexicon where each word possesses a well-defined meaning. This process filters out common function words (e.g., ‘a’, ‘the’, ‘in’) that lack conceptual weight. Finally, to minimize redundancy, we use CLIP text embeddings to compute cosine similarity between all pairs of concepts and, for each pair where similarity exceeds0.90.9，我们修剪不太常见的概念。对于与目标类太相似的概念，我们也做同样的事情。其他, we prune the less frequent concept. 确定最佳词汇量。Determining Optimal Vocabulary Size.在足够全面以解释感兴趣行为的大多数实例的词汇表和足够小以确保解释的枚举在给定超时内保持可计算性的词汇表之间存在大小权衡。 我们定义以下测试来评估词汇表是否包含足够的概念。There exists a size trade-off between a vocabulary comprehensive enough to explain most instances of a behavior of interest and one small enough to ensure that enumeration of explanations remains computable within a given time-out. We define the following test to evaluate if a vocabulary contains enough concepts.

Note, when testing with SpLiCE-based erasure, we have to account for the fact that the embedding can change even if no concepts are erased since SpLiCE first computes a sparse decomposition of the original embedding and then computes a new embedding from this sparse decomposition. We discard any image for which SpLiCE’s concept decomposition leads to a prediction different from that of the unmodified embedding, i.e., such images are not included in the numerator of the expression in DefinitionE.1.

定制词汇。Customized Vocabularies.除了我们评估中使用的特定词汇之外，我们方法的一个关键优势是其灵活性，因为它不限于特定词汇。可以选择概念来满足特定需求，例如将集合限制为视觉概念以获得更好的视觉基础，或合并特定领域的概念以提高专业任务（例如黑色素瘤分类）的解释准确性Beyond the specific vocabularies used in our evaluation, a key strength of our approach is its flexibility, as it is not restricted to a specific vocabulary. Concepts can be selected to suit specific needs, such as limiting the set to visual concepts for better visual grounding or incorporating domain-specific concepts to improve explanatory accuracy in specialized tasks, such as melanoma classificationDreyer et al. (2025)。这种适应性允许个性化解释，以匹配不同受众的背景知识，例如，通过在教育环境中选择易于理解的概念。此外，调整词汇的能力与文献中交互式和可操作解释的定义一致. This adaptability allows for the personalization of explanations to match the background knowledge of different audiences, e.g., by selecting accessible concepts in educational settings. Furthermore, the ability to adjust the vocabulary aligns with the definitions of interactive and actionable explanations found in the literatureSokol and Flach (2020)，因为它使用户能够细化粒度以满足他们的需求，并为实现期望的结果提供具体的行动。, as it enables users to refine granularity to suit their needs and provides concrete actions toward a desired outcome.

G.5 RQ5：效率RQ5: Efficiency

我们将擦除算法与解释枚举算法的每次组合所需的时间进行比较，以计算每个图像的解释。我们将每个这样的组合称为We compare the time required per combination of an erasure algorithm with an explanation enumeration algorithm to compute explanations per image. We refer to each such combination as a配置configuration.

三种擦除算法表现出不同程度的计算可重用性，这直接影响其计算时间。 Ortho利用了一系列可以预先计算和重复使用的矩阵运算，从而导致执行时间很短。类似地，虽然 SpLiCE 最初需要解决每个图像嵌入的数值优化问题，但所产生的概念强度可以重复使用，以使后续擦除更加高效。相比之下，LEACE 使用训练数据来计算协方差矩阵，并为每个特定擦除计算仿射变换。因此，虽然重复相同的擦除速度很快，但擦除不同的概念集需要新的计算，从而导致计算时间更长。一个实用的简写是将 LEACE 中间结果存储在内存中；然而，这仅在重复相同的擦除时才可行，例如涉及下面讨论的 NaiveEnum 算法的情况。The three erasure algorithms exhibit varying degrees of reusability of computation which directly impacts their computation times. Ortho utilizes a series of matrix operations that can be pre-calculated and reused, resulting in a short time for execution. Similarly, while SpLiCE initially requires solving a numerical optimization for each image embedding, the resulting concept strengths can be reused to make subsequent erasures efficient. In contrast, LEACE uses training data to compute a covariance matrix and calculates an affine transformation for each specific erasure. As a result, while repeating the same erasure is fast, erasing different sets of concepts requires new calculations, leading to longer computation times. A practical shorthand is to store the LEACE intermediate results in memory; however, this is only feasible when repeating identical erasures, such as in cases involving the NaiveEnum algorithm discussed below.

三种解释枚举算法以不同的方式探索解释空间，这会影响其计算时间。 NaiveEnum 的计算时间主要由搜索深度决定The three explanation enumeration algorithms explore the space of explanations in different manners which impacts their computation times. The computation time for NaiveEnum is primarily determined by the search depthKK，其次是词汇量大小和图像数量。通过将搜索深度固定为, followed by the vocabulary size and the number of images. By fixing the search depth atK=2K=2，我们保持易处理性，同时关注最有效的解释，这些解释是那些具有最高个人覆盖率的解释，如第节中的经验所示, we maintain tractability while focusing on the most effective explanations, which are those with the highest individual coverage as empirically shown in Section5.2.3。对于由 700 张图像和 150 到 300 个概念之间的词汇组成的行为，Ortho 和 SpLiCE 的计算时间相似，从 1 小时 30 分钟到 2 小时不等。相反，只有当所有搜索到的解释都存储了预先计算的中间结果时，使用 LEACE 才可行。在这些情况下，第一张图像需要总时间的很大一部分，但后续图像的处理时间较短，因为不涉及进一步的训练。虽然这种方法可以很好地适应图像数量，但词汇量大小仍然是一个关键限制；探索 150 个概念需要近 2 小时，而探索 500 个概念则需要大约 10 小时。. For behaviors consisting of 700 images each and vocabularies between 150 and 300 concepts, both Ortho and SpLiCE show similar computation times, ranging from 1h30m to 2h. In contrast, using LEACE is only feasible if the pre-computed intermediate results are stored for all searched explanations. In these cases, the first image requires a significant portion of the total time, but subsequent images are processed in a shorter time because no further training is involved. While this approach scales well with the number of images, the vocabulary size remains a critical constraint; exploring 150 concepts takes nearly 2h, whereas 500 concepts require about 10h.

以 XpEnum 为例（详见附录In the case of XpEnum (detailed in AppendixB），当与 Ortho 或 SpLiCE 结合使用时，该算法是生成解释的最快配置，报告每个 700 个图像的行为的计算时间为 5 到 10 分钟。根据经验，词汇量大小和图像数量对计算时间的影响大致相当，这与 NaiveEnum 形成鲜明对比，NaiveEnum 中词汇量大小比图像数量的影响更大。 XpEnum 探索搜索空间的不可预测的方式使其成为与 LEACE 配合使用时第二慢的配置。我们凭经验观察到，该算法通常在早期迭代中找到 ConCXps，然后过渡到 ConAXps 和 ConCXps 之间的交替，最后只专注于 ConAXps；然而，由于在遍历过程中很少重用预先计算的中间结果，因此计算时间经常超过我们的 10 小时超时。在这些情况下，必须中断该过程，通常是在获得任何 ConAXps 之前。深入研究这种枚举算法以减少计算时间留待未来的工作。), when used in conjunction with Ortho or SpLiCE, this algorithm is the fastest configuration for generating explanations, reporting computation times between 5 and 10 minutes for behaviors of 700 images each. Empirically, the impact of vocabulary size and the number of images on the computation time is roughly equivalent, which contrasts with NaiveEnum, where vocabulary size was much more impactful than the number of images. The unpredictable way XpEnum explores the search space makes it the second slowest configuration when paired with LEACE. We empirically observe that the algorithm typically finds ConCXps in early iterations, transitions into alternating between ConAXps and ConCXps, and finally focuses exclusively on ConAXps; however, because pre-computed intermediate results are rarely reused during this traversal, computation times frequently exceed our 10h timeout. In these cases, the process must be interrupted, often before any ConAXps are obtained. An in-depth study of this enumeration algorithm to reduce computation time is left as future work.

XpSatEnum 的计算时间直接由发现的解释的数量和要饱和的图像决定。虽然词汇量也有一定影响，但其影响力不如这两个因素。当与 Ortho 或 SpLiCE 配合使用每个具有 700 个图像的行为时，计算时间会因解释数量而异。在所探索的行为中，Ortho 平均为 5 小时，SpLiCE 平均为 2 小时，具体执行时间从 30 分钟到 8.5 小时不等。 XpSatEnum 和 LEACE 的组合是最慢的配置，因为扩展瓶颈可能超过 40 GB GPU 内存限制。首先，要检查的解释数量约为数千。其次，对于一幅图像来说子集最小的解释对于其他图像来说可能只是一个弱解释，需要进一步修剪以保证最小性。这导致所需检查的数量呈指数级增长。在这些情况下，不同候选者之间缺乏可重用性会导致算法无法在合理的时间内完成。The computation time for XpSatEnum is directly determined by the number of discovered explanations and the images to be saturated. While vocabulary size plays a role, it is less impactful than these two factors. When paired with Ortho or SpLiCE for behaviors with 700 images each, computation time varies by behavior due to the number of explanations. Ortho averages 5 hours, and SpLiCE averages 2 hours among the behaviors explored, with specific executions spanning from 30 minutes to 8.5 hours. The combination of XpSatEnum and LEACE is the slowest configuration due to scaling bottlenecks that can exceed a 40 GB GPU memory limit. First, the number of explanations to check is in the order of thousands. Second, an explanation that is subset-minimal for one image may only be a weak explanation for others, requiring further pruning to guarantee minimality. This leads to an exponential increase in required checks. In these cases, the lack of reusability across diverse candidates prevents the algorithm from completing in a reasonable time.

总的来说，尽管正式的解释方法通常难以扩展到大型模型和数据集，但我们的方法在可扩展性和解释质量之间提供了合理的权衡。 Ortho 和 SpLiCE 与 XpEnum 配合使用是在短时间内发现 ConAXps 和 ConCXps 的最快配置。虽然 XpSatEnum 由于执行检查以保证最小性而计算成本最高，但它通过构造提供了比 XpEnum 更高的最大覆盖范围的优势。相比之下，当与 NaiveEnum 的可预测搜索模式配合使用以查找短 ConCXps 时，LEACE 速度最快，因为此配置利用了预先计算的中间结果。Overall, although formal explanation methods often struggle to scale to large models and datasets, our approach offers a reasonable trade-off between scalability and explanation quality. Ortho and SpLiCE paired with XpEnum are the fastest configurations for discovering both ConAXps and ConCXps within a short time. While XpSatEnum is the most computationally expensive due to the checks it performs to guarantee minimality, it offers the advantage of higher maximum coverage than XpEnum by construction. In contrast, LEACE is fastest when paired with NaiveEnum’s predictable search pattern for finding short ConCXps, as this configuration leverages precomputed intermediate results.

G.6 长度 K 处的相对累积个体覆盖率Relative Cumulative Individual Coverage at Length K

我们定义了一个补充指标来量化 ConXps 的简洁性，其直觉是人类分析师更容易理解较短的解释。之前的工作We define a complementary metric to quantify the conciseness of ConXps, motivated by the intuition that shorter explanations are more accessible to human analysts. Prior workRamaswamy et al. (2023)认为单个解释中包含的概念数量应受到 32 个严格上限的限制，以符合人类偏好。这项研究还指出，最大比例的参与者更喜欢少于 16 个概念，并且每个解释最多仅使用 8 个概念即可实现最高准确度。argues that the number of concepts contained in a single explanation should be limited by a strict upper bound of 32 to align with human preferences. This study also notes that the largest percentage of participants prefer fewer than 16 concepts, and the highest accuracy was achieved with a maximum of only 8 concepts per explanation.

为了评估我们的结果如何符合这些人类偏好，我们使用长度的相对累积个人覆盖率To evaluate how our results match these human preferences, we use the Relative Cumulative Individual Coverage at LengthKK衡量给定行为内解释长度分布的度量metric to measure the distribution of explanation lengths within a given behaviorBB。对于特定阈值. For a specific thresholdKK，该指标计算为所有解释的各个覆盖范围的累积总和，其中包括, this metric is calculated as the cumulative sum of the individual coverages of all explanations consisting ofKK或更少的概念，通过所有长度的解释总数进行标准化。小成绩高分or fewer concepts, normalized by the total number of explanations across all lengths. A high score at a smallKK表示大多数解释都很简短且易于解释。indicates that the majority of explanations are short and easy to interpret.

图Figure18绘制相对累积个人覆盖率与长度的关系图plots the Relative Cumulative Individual Coverage against the LengthKK对于正文中的每个评估行为。在所有情况下，大多数解释包括for each evaluated behavior in the main text. Across all cases, the majority of explanations consist ofK≤8K\leq 8概念，表明我们的方法与之前确定的人类准确度最佳范围一致concepts, showing that our approach aligns with the range previously identified as optimal for human accuracyRamaswamy et al. (2023)。在这些结果中，LEACE CXp 和 Ortho AXp 报告了小尺寸的最高累积频率。. Among these results, LEACE CXp and Ortho AXp report the highest Cumulative Frequencies for smallKK值，表明它们是最简洁的。相比之下，Ortho CXp 和 SpLiCE AXp 在大多数情况下往往会产生最长的解释。values, indicating they are the most concise. In contrast, Ortho CXp and SpLiCE AXp tend to produce the longest explanations in most cases.

G.8 定性分析Qualitative Analysis

我们通过两个用例探索 ConXps 如何帮助人类分析师评估视觉模型的行为。首先，我们发现模型如何消除具有多种潜在含义的概念的歧义。其次，我们基于 ConXps 执行像素空间转换并报告模型的响应。We explore how ConXps can assist human analysts in evaluating vision models’ behaviors through two use cases. First, we find how models disambiguate concepts with multiple potential meanings. Second, we perform pixel-space transformations based on ConXps and report the model’s response.

G.8.1 多义消歧Polysemantic Disambiguation

我们发现我们的解释能够识别多义术语并消除它们的歧义。在We have found that our explanations are able to identify polysemous terms and disambiguate them. This explanation suggests that the model may initially associate湾bay及其在马方面的用法，例如流行的马颜色。要求为with its usage in equine contexts, such as the popular horse color. G.8.2 像素空间变换Pixel-space Transformations

获得 ConCXp 意味着从模型的内部表示中删除特定概念必然会改变其预测。为了评估模型对像素级干预的响应，我们使用扩散模型进行了实验Obtaining a ConCXp implies that erasing specific concepts from a model’s internal representation will necessarily shift its prediction. To evaluate the model’s response to pixel-level interventions, we conducted an experiment using a diffusion modelWu et al. (2025)直接对输入图像执行语义编辑。我们测试了在像素级别擦除这些概念是否会翻转模型的预测，模仿概念擦除的效果。我们转换了ConCXps中所有概念对应的像素to perform semantic edits directly on the input images. We tested whether erasing these concepts at the pixel level would flip the model’s prediction, mimicking the effect of concept erasure. We transformed the pixels corresponding to all concepts in the ConCXps{Sea​(+)∧Freight(+)},{Racks​(+)∧Wildlife(+)},{Driver​(+)∧Parking(+)},\{\text{Sea}(+)\wedge\text{Freight(+)}\},\{\text{Racks}(+)\wedge\text{Wildlife(+)}\},\{\text{Driver}(+)\wedge\text{Parking(+)}\},和and{Marsh​(+)∧Aquarium(+)}\{\text{Marsh}(+)\wedge\text{Aquarium(+)}\}从班级图像中from images of the classes船ship, 鹿deer, 汽车car, 和, and青蛙frog，分别；如图, respectively; as shown in Figure19。 图. Figure20包含额外的例子contains additional examples for the鹿deer, 汽车car, 和, and青蛙frog类及其相应的提示模板。我们还探索了替代像素替代品classes and their corresponding prompt template. We also explored alternative pixel replacements for the海sea中的概念concept in船ship图片，如图images, as shown in Figure21。我们没有用白色替换这些像素，而是用代表的纹理替换它们. 尽管有这些语义干预，所有行为中 96% 的修改图像仍然被正确预测为其原始类别，例如，替换Despite these semantic interventions, 96% of the modified images across all behaviors are still correctly predicted as their original classes, e.g., replacing海sea和and货运freight中的相关像素-related pixels in船ship图像没有改变模型的输出。为了分析原因，我们通过视觉编码器提供了修改后的图像，并测量了结果嵌入和概念向量之间的余弦相似度，如第 1 节中所定义。images did not change the model’s output. To analyze why, we provided the modified images through the vision encoders and measured the cosine similarity between the resulting embeddings and the concept vectors, as defined in Section2.2.1和附录and AppendixD。我们发现在像素级别删除的概念在嵌入级别仍然积极存在。这与直接应用于嵌入的擦除算法形成鲜明对比，后者将概念强度降低为零。该模型的正确分类是合理的，因为尽管像素级发生了变化，但预测所需的概念仍然存在于嵌入中。这些结果支持这样的发现：视觉编码器根据上下文线索推断和编码概念，即使代表这些概念的特定像素被替换。. We found that concepts removed at the pixel level remain positively present at the embedding level. This contrasts with erasure algorithms applied directly to the embeddings, which reduce concept strength to zero. The model’s correct classification is justified because the concepts required for the prediction remain present in the embedding despite the pixel-level changes. These results support the finding that vision encoders infer and encode concepts from contextual cues, even when the specific pixels representing those concepts are replaced.
